versions.changelog:
- Improved sitemap filtering to include individual blog post pages as valid link-back targets and post topics, while still excluding blog index and pagination pages.
- Updated documentation to reflect the new handling of blog pages in the social calendar pipeline.
- Minor internal code adjustments in sitemap and post generation scripts to support these changes.

- Added Gemini and FAL image APIs to the list of tested and supported options for image generation.
- Updated documentation to reflect expanded image API compatibility.

- Updated image API information in documentation: Gemini and FAL replaced with DeepSeek and ChatGPT as tested image generation options.
- Clarified tested APIs in SKILL.md, reflecting actual supported providers.
- No changes to functionality; documentation only.

- Added tested and working notes: verified compatibility with DeepSeek, ChatGPT (OpenAI), Gemini, and FAL APIs.
- Confirmed the pipeline is functional end-to-end, including sitemap fetch, post generation, CSV output, and SSH image upload.
- No changes to main functionality or usage; documentation update only.

- Added interactive mode for client detail entry: run without flags to be prompted for each detail step-by-step.
- SKILL.md and documentation updated to reflect interactive client detail option.
- Minor script and documentation improvements.

- Enhanced sitemap handling: the tool now fetches and filters the client's sitemap to generate post topics and link-back URLs, focusing on real service and area pages.
- Updated documentation to clarify that the sitemap is required and is the primary source for post content and URLs.
- Improved description and usage examples in SKILL.md for better onboarding and transparency.

- Clarified that generated images are uploaded to your web host via SSH or FTP, with public URLs automatically written into the CSV.
- Updated requirements and documentation to reflect this image hosting workflow.
- Improved instructions for setting up SSH/FTP credentials.
- Minor documentation edits for consistency and clarity.

Version 1.0.0 of 90-day-social-generator

- Initial release of the 90-day social media calendar generator.
- Generates HighLevel Social Planner CSVs containing 45 AI-written posts (every other day) with a unique post, URL, and AI-generated image per entry.
- Supports two modes: auto-fetching client details via HighLevel, or manual detail entry.
- Requires API keys for AI content and images; supports DeepSeek, OpenAI/ChatGPT-compatible LLMs, and multiple image providers.
- Option to generate image URLs via your own FTP/SSH-hosted server.
- Output is ready for direct import to HighLevel Social Planner.
